subject: Reseller onboarding for marketplace renewal — billing path & PO flow
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Finance <procurement@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller opportunity & marketplace renewal

Hi Sergio — great talking yesterday. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can lock timelines with our procurement team:

- We plan to resell Redwood offerings in EU and UK marketplaces, primarily via AWS Marketplace SaaS and third-party reseller routing.
- Target initial commit: 120k units (token-equivalent) over 12 months, with phased ramp in Q3.
- Procurement wants Redwood to invoice CloudBridge directly (reseller model) instead of end-customer pass-through. Can you confirm Redwood supports reseller-level private offers and invoice-to-reseller flow?
- We also need a reseller discount schedule (volume tiers) and the reseller addendum / MSA language.

Attached preliminary docs: reseller_agreement_draft.pdf and pricing grid. Can your marketplace/legal folks review the addendum and confirm evidence/acceptance requirements (private-offer acceptance, proof-of-usage mapping, tax/VAT handling)?

Timeline: procurement needs paperwork + PO to route in by April 12 to align with their fiscal close. Can Redwood commit to a 2-week review window?

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Resellers
liam@cloudbridge.com
---
Attachment: cloudbridge_reseller_agreement_draft.pdf (PDF, 132KB)
Attachment: reseller_pricing_grid.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller opportunity & marketplace renewal

Hey Liam — thanks for the clear summary and the files. Looping in Marissa (Marketplace Partnerships) and Kim (Cloud Billing) so we can align on operational pieces.

High level we can support reseller-led private offers, but there are a few important items to align on:

1) Invoicing model: Redwood typically invoices the bill-to party on the private-offer. We need written confirmation that CloudBridge will be the bill-to for the private offers you plan to activate.

2) Marketplace routing & payouts: AWS/GCP have different payout windows and fee pass-throughs for reseller flows. We'll coordinate the payout cadence and any marketplace fees that affect net pricing.

3) Acceptance/evidence: For staggered activation we require either the end-customer acceptance window or a reseller commitment PO that maps to the private-offer line items.

4) Tax/VAT & KYC: We'll need reseller's VAT ID, W-8/W-9 equivalent (if applicable), and KYC paperwork for finance.

Marissa/Kim — can you confirm the expected docs list and an initial review ETA? Liam, if you can share the reseller VAT ID and the proposed PO template, that will speed things up.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
---
Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller opportunity & marketplace renewal

Thanks Sergio and Liam — scope clarified. Below is the proposed onboarding checklist and the operational notes from Marketplace & Finance. Please treat as required items for acceptance: 

Reseller onboarding checklist (Redwood):
- Signed Reseller Addendum (we attach standard template).
- Reseller VAT ID and proof of registration.
- PO from CloudBridge referencing Redwood private-offer SKU(s) and quantities (template attached).
- Completed KYC form + banking info for payouts.
- Confirmation of invoicing relationship (bill-to = CloudBridge).
- DocuSign link for private-offer acceptance (we will generate once the addendum is signed).

Operational notes:
- Marketplace flows: AWS allows private offers invoiced to reseller if the private-offer ownership is set to the reseller account. GCP requires a reseller mapping and can take longer to set up (typically 7-10 business days after DocuSign).
- Payout cadence: Net-30 after monthly close; marketplace fees will reduce reseller margin — we recommend building in a 7% fee buffer.
- Evidence for acceptance: Either (A) end-customer acceptance record in AWS, or (B) CloudBridge PO mapped to SKUs + monthly usage reconciliation report.

Attachments: reseller_addendum_template.docx (please redline and return).
Related links: HubSpot deal DL-4729 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4729), Redwood reseller playbook (internal drive link).

ETA: We can review redlines within 5 business days after you return the signed addendum + PO. If CloudBridge needs accelerated review to hit the April 12 procurement window, we can prioritize but will need explicit sign-off to bypass the standard 10-business-day legal cycle.

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
---
Attachment: reseller_addendum_template.docx (DOCX, 18KB)

From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudbridge.com>, CloudBridge Finance <procurement@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller opportunity & marketplace renewal

Marissa — thanks, received. A few quick points from legal/procurement after reviewing your checklist and our internal constraints:

- We will sign the reseller addendum but will redline a single clause around indemnity limits. Expect the redline back by EOD Friday.
- Procurement confirms they will be bill-to and will include the private-offer SKU references on the PO. We will share the PO template by tomorrow morning.
- Tax/VAT: CloudBridge is VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT ID: IE1234567A). I attached the registration certificate in a follow-up to procurement.
- Timeline: We appreciate the 5-business-day review option. To meet our April 12 window we request Redwood to prioritize DocuSign generation once the redlined addendum is returned. Can Kimberly confirm that finance will accept the PO + VAT certificate and proceed to set up the reseller billing lane?

Thanks — Anna
Anna Ruiz
Legal Counsel, CloudBridge Resellers
anna.ruiz@cloudbridge.com
